source_root_cause.marketing_app_store_cta: TikTok is not in LINKABLE_PLATFORMS, so its fallback CTA is Link in bio for the app.
source_root_cause.marketing_slide_pack_factory: English last-slide CTA is platform-independent Link in bio.
source_root_cause.rotation: Existing approved TikTok pool candidates are reusable for seven days, so changing generation alone leaves 15 false-CTA packs eligible.

proposed_source_fix.tiktok_caption_cta: Search Anicca on the App Store
proposed_source_fix.tiktok_last_slide_cta: Search Anicca on the App Store
proposed_source_fix.old_pool_handling: Exclude candidates containing a false link-in-bio CTA in any slide or caption at selection time; preserve all immutable objects and ledger history.
proposed_source_fix.publisher_guard: Reject any TikTok pack containing a false link-in-bio CTA before token lookup or provider access.
proposed_source_fix.caption_normalization: Remove the retired English or Japanese TikTok link-in-bio line before appending the App Store search CTA.
proposed_source_fix.gate: Reject unavailable link-in-bio CTAs for TikTok and require the App Store search CTA.
proposed_source_fix.new_pack_generation: Existing deterministic copy and cached backgrounds
